A win for the First Amendment. 

@JudiciaryGOP’s investigation exposed how the Biden Administration pressured Big Tech to censor American speech online. 

Today, the U.S. government signed a 10-year consent decree finally admitting it colluded with these companies to silence Americans. 

One step closer to stopping the censorship-industrial complex.

Congratulations to Secretary Mullin on being sworn in.

He will do a great job leading DHS and serving the American people.

Colin McDonald is the right guy for the job. 

He will protect American tax dollars, crack down on rampant fraud in Democrat-run states, and restore accountability as Assistant Attorney General of Fraud Enforcement.


Senate Cloakroom (@SenateCloakroom)

Confirmed, 52-47: Confirmation of Executive Calendar #697 Colin McDonald to be an Assistant Attorney General.



— https://nitter.net/SenateCloakroom/status/2036519919135686835#m
